<!-- pr-reviewer: 98b1a2f10fed7f88ef7f7433098f0680312deba4 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Safety-tier review (P1 "main is red", #2306).

### What looks good
- The PR changes only test files and one decision file. No file in `crates/*/src` changes.
- No "never posts", refusal or gouge assert is removed, loosened or moved behind a new condition. Each "held by the operation" branch keeps its old asserts and adds `oblique_refused(...)`. Thus the condition is stronger.
- The 1e-4 mm tolerance applies only to the fixture stock-box checks in X and Y (`circular_pick_law.rs` `job` and `fixture_stock_covers_the_part_in_both_cases`, the same two in `trochoid_law.rs`, `keep_law.rs` `job`). Z stays at 1e-9. No gouge or deviation threshold changes.
- `pocket_support::stock_turn`, `OBLIQUE` and `oblique_refused` are equal to the `area_support` helpers on `main`.
- The PR body and `docs/decisions/2306-red-refusal-suites.md` say plainly that the chamfer hole is not fixed here and is #2308 (P1). #2308 gives the reproducing case: the fixture, the steps, and the result for the aligned, quarter-turned and 1e-6 rad stock.

### Results (merged with main, locally)
The head already contains `origin/main` `7e26134bf` (`git merge` said "Already up to date"). Debug build, `-j 6`, `--test-threads=6`.

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `pocket3d_open_side` | 7 passed |
| `circular_pick_law` | 5 passed |
| `kept_parts_live` | 4 passed |
| `stock_source_holes` | 9 passed |
| `trochoid_law` | 7 passed |
| `keep_law` | 31 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Mutation checks (local, reverted before this comment)
1. `posting_sim::judge_clause`: the `Err` arm does not call `kept_moved` (no live re-judge). Result: `kept_parts_live` 3 failed, `pocket3d_open_side` 2 failed, `stock_source_holes` 3 failed (`chamfer_refusal_names_cause...` included).
2. `posting.rs` (WARN records of the section): drop each warning that contains "cuts past the finish surface". Result: `circular_pick_law` 1 failed, `trochoid_law` 3 failed, `keep_law` 6 failed.

Thus the changed tests still fail when the operation's own check does not hold the post. They test what their names say.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- The case "chamfer-rejudge-hint" passes because the 1e-6 rad stock makes the sim refuse, and then the live re-judge runs. The suite does not show that the aligned and quarter-turned stocks post. The PR does not claim that. A pinning test for those two stocks can come with the #2308 fix, as #2308 proposes.
- The `re_world` of "chamfer-rejudge-hint" has no own `oblique_refused` assert. It uses the same `job(..., true)` device, and the `rotated` world above it asserts the device. Add the assert when this test changes next.
- The commit type is `fix(test)`. The PR changes only tests, so `test:` is the better type. This has no effect on a cut.
- `pocket3d_open_side.rs` stays over 400 lines (422). The PR does not make it longer.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| fix (issue worker, #2306) | not known | not known | not known |
| review (PR-reviewer, safety tier) | Opus 5.5 | not known | not known |
The review agent cannot read its own token total. The dispatcher can add the totals from the completion notices. Main-session coordination is not counted.
Effort: effort:high (no escalation)
